findings.detail: Read exact CohInp19–24 and compared BX8 and KB8. The four extracted fields retain the same original finite-module local cohomology, normalized Poitou–Tate, global finiteness and Euler statements. The prime-two Euler expression and separate odd-prime higher-vanishing guard are distinguished. KB8 supplies the actual LemmaK31 with its HasMuQ guard and single exponent selected before all varying arithmetic data.

Read literal InpZ55–61. Its fields are precisely lemM, lemMprime, lemP, rigII, adK and number. Compared the complete printed SP6/SP1/FP8/ADK6 conclusions with the new assembly. SP1 retains finite residue and an additive, not necessarily linear, injection; FP8 retains exact weighted generator/equation counts and all original framed hypotheses.

KTR13 has been independently reviewed in full. KIZ preserves the literal universal IsExt-to-IsModular antecedent, actual local point/marked-element guards and full nine-dimensional adjoint. It constructs no replacement datum and does not infer the antecedent. ADK6 supplies its exact original full polarized CM adjoint statement, including the scalar part and full infinite-cyclotomic condition.

RNC16 has the fixed-K constants before weights, levels, primes and indexed orbits; the single nonzero integer precedes every later coefficient datum and admissible family. KIZ preserves the rank-three/rank-two-block disjunction, original Frobenius inverse and coefficient-prime scope. No rank-four congruence statement is substituted.
